availability.join: Companyfacts accn to SEC submissions accession_number

actions.positive: common-share repurchase; retirement is confirmation and not double-counted
actions.negative: cash common-equity issuance plus convertible-debt and convertible-preferred proceeds
actions.excluded: employee options, share compensation, acquisition consideration, debt balance without proceeds

normalization.flow: reported USD times 365 divided by matching period duration days
normalization.market_cap: exact-available shares outstanding times raw close at last completed NYSE session
normalization.market_cap_quality_gate: shares >= 100000 and USD market cap between 1000000 and 20000000000000; invalid is neutral

source_screen.entry: first NYSE close strictly after exact accepted_at
source_screen.pass: full/OOS/OOS2 63D spread > 0 and OOS/OOS2 filing-week bootstrap lower >= 0

stop_rules.underpowered_or_reject: no portfolio A/B and no retuning

pit_caveats: current identity map is not historical membership
multi-class issuer market cap can be incomplete
Companyfacts tag absence is not evidence of zero action
